provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: EverQuest Legends lists all EverQuest playable races at launch, including Iksar, Froglok, and Kerran.

notice: Race can limit the primary class at character creation. Check the live character-creation screen before locking a primary.

races.name: Human
strengths: Flexible for many primary-class plans.
Antonica hubs help early travel and faction work.
tradeoffs: A broad fit, not a narrow specialist.

provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: Launch roster and Antonica start; flexibility is a community guide summary.

races.name: Barbarian
strengths: Strong for physical frontline and two-handed melee plans.
Halas gives an Antonica route.
tradeoffs: Caster-first plans gain little from this profile.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides describe a melee focus; values are offline planning estimates.

races.name: Erudite
strengths: Strong for caster and control-first trios.
Odus provides a clear early caster route.
tradeoffs: Frontline melee needs support from classes and gear.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides place Erudite with caster primaries; values are estimates.

races.name: Halfling
strengths: Useful for mobile, utility, and faction-conscious routes.
Rivervale provides an Antonica start.
tradeoffs: Adds less to a heavy frontline plan.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guidance links Halfling with Druid and mobile leveling; values are estimates.

races.name: Gnome
strengths: Good for utility and caster-leaning plans.
Ak'Anon gives a Faydwer route.
tradeoffs: Adds little to a pure durability goal.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community references place Gnome with Faydwer utility-caster planning.

races.name: Dwarf
strengths: Strong for durable melee and tank-first trios.
Kaladim gives a Faydwer start.
tradeoffs: Caster-heavy plans may prefer another profile.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides commonly rank Dwarf for durable melee planning; values are estimates.

races.name: High Elf
strengths: Strong for caster and control-focused trios.
Felwithe gives a Faydwer route.
tradeoffs: Frontline durability comes from the class kit and gear.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides place High Elf with wizard and enchanter planning; values are estimates.

races.name: Wood Elf
strengths: Good for mobile outdoor, Ranger, and Druid plans.
Kelethin supports travel-minded routes.
tradeoffs: Adds less to a pure plate-tank plan.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community material connects Wood Elf with Ranger/Druid travel; values are estimates.

races.name: Half Elf
strengths: Flexible for Ranger, Bard, and Paladin-style hybrids.
Antonica hubs support mixed goals.
tradeoffs: A broad fit rather than a maxed specialist.

provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: Community EQL guides identify Half Elf as a flexible hybrid start; scores are estimates.

races.name: Dark Elf
strengths: Strong for caster and dark-magic themed trios.
Neriak heritage gives a focused Faydwer route.
tradeoffs: Faction access needs care for good-aligned hubs.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community EQL guides connect Dark Elf with Necromancer and Shadow Knight plans; values are estimates.

races.name: Troll
strengths: Strong for sustained melee and frontline plans.
Community guides value regeneration for long solo fights.
tradeoffs: Travel and faction routes need more planning.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides cite Troll regeneration; values are estimates.

races.name: Ogre
strengths: Strong for tank-first trios and taking hits.
Community guides value frontal stun resistance.
tradeoffs: Travel and faction routes need more planning.

provenance.label: heuristic/inference
provenance.reference: Community guides cite Ogre tank benefits; values are estimates.

races.name: Kerran
strengths: Strong for agile melee, Monk, and Beastlord plans.
Odus provides its distinct starting route.
tradeoffs: Caster-first trios gain less from this profile.

provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: EQL confirms Kerran and Kerra Isle; class fit is community guidance.

races.name: Iksar
strengths: Good for Monk, Shadow Knight, and Necromancer plans.
Playable at launch although Kunark is a later destination.
tradeoffs: Check current faction and start-route details in game.

provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: EQL confirms Iksar is playable at launch; class-fit scoring is a community estimate.

races.name: Froglok
strengths: Balanced for support, plate, and mixed-role trios.
Playable at launch with visible armor.
tradeoffs: Balanced rather than the highest score for a narrow role.

provenance.label: EQL-sourced
provenance.reference: EQL confirms Froglok at launch; balance scores are community estimates.
